key_insight: Combining complementary datasets in a composable training and fitting pipeline enables a single body-fitting method that is both locally expressive (hands, face, fine geometry) and globally robust (clothing, pose variation, noise, partial scans).
problem_solved: Aligning parametric body models (e.g., SMPL) to raw 3D point clouds of clothed humans while preserving fine details and remaining robust to clothing, diverse poses, sensor noise, and incomplete scans.
method: Composable dataset assembly: curate and combine specialized datasets (hands, faces, clothed scans, diverse poses, noisy/partial captures) with stratified sampling to cover complementary failure modes.

Hybrid fitting pipeline: a modular approach that couples global robust optimization/prior with local high-resolution refinements (per-part or high-frequency detail modules) to capture fine geometry while staying stable.

Cross-dataset regularization & augmentation: train with dataset-aware losses, synthetic augmentations and consistency constraints to prevent overfitting and improve generalization to real-world clothed humans.
impact: Provides a practical, generalizable body-fitting tool that reduces manual cleanup and improves downstream tasks (animation, texturing, avatar creation) by delivering more accurate and reliable fits on real, clothed scans.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: composable datasets feeding a two-stage fit (global robust fit → local high-detail refinement).
Before/after overlays: raw clothed point cloud vs fitted SMPL showing improved hands/face/detail and maintained global alignment.
Robustness chart: performance comparison across datasets/conditions (clothing types, noise levels, partial scans) showing reduced failure modes.
Dataset mosaic: icons/tiles representing different dataset types (hands, faces, clothed bodies, noisy/partial captures) to illustrate composability.
paper_title: ETCH-X: Robustify Expressive Body Fitting to Clothed Humans with Composable Datasets
paper_authors: Xiaoben Li, Jingyi Wu, Zeyu Cai, Yu Siyuan, Boqian Li
